title: Render's Valley
wikitext:
[[Image:Render's Valley.jpg|thumb|300px|Render's Valley]]
'''Render's Valley''' is an [[orcish]] outpost in the southeastern [[Redridge Mountains]]. The valley, much like [[Render's Camp]] and [[Render's Rock]], is named after [[Rend Blackhand]] and contains a number of [[Blackrock Clan|Blackrock]] orcs. The orcs here are not as powerful as the ones in the northwest. A [[Captured Servant of Azora]] in one of the valley's camps offers special tailoring supplies to adventurers who can reach him.

The mountains just south of Render's Valley contain an "undocumented" and hard to find mountain pass to the [[Swamp of Sorrows]].
